references.text: Reference to the first defeat at Ai, where the men of Israel fled before the men of Ai, which is the background for the strategy of pretending to flee again.
The fulfillment of the plan described in verse 6, where Joshua and the people pretend to flee, and the men of Ai pursue them.
The preceding verse describing the beginning of the military strategy of which verse 6 is a part.
A similar military strategy was used by the tribe of Benjamin, who lured the enemy out of the city by pretending to flee.
The tribe of Benjamin used the same ambush tactic that Joshua used against Ai.
